description: This file defines the HeartbeatStore singleton class used for managing heartbeat events and notifications, including decoding data and updating its lastEvent property.

classes.name: HeartbeatStore
classes.description: A singleton class used for observing heartbeat notifications, decoding events, and maintaining the last heartbeat event state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the HeartbeatStore, sets up notification observer, and fetches last heartbeat asynchronously.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes the observer on deinitialization to prevent memory leaks.
